result_label: provisional derivative criterion labels; not human gold
causal_findings: The workbench used Bash exactly as intended: bounded covenant arithmetic on Banking and allocation recomputation on Tax, each returning fewer than 700 characters. It did not use Bash for ingestion.
Useful after-read computation nevertheless required another inference over the full evidence prefix. Tax workbench input rose from 267255 to 537462 while only 1536 input tokens were reported cached.
Indenture workbench used no Bash but authored two deliverables in separate model turns, raising input from 209308 to 451840. Control emitted both generation calls together.

The deterministic packet surfaced concrete prior misses, but every compiler revision became materially shorter. It lost more correct coverage than it gained on Banking and Indenture; its Tax gain was only three criteria at 2.21x cache-adjusted input.
Across all tasks, every added post-read round reduced aggregate accuracy and increased cost. The control is the winner and both candidate deltas are rejected.

decision.next_hypothesis: Keep all analysis and completeness work inside the single evidence-to-deliverable inference. Test a two-tool one-shot surface with exact task recency after the source packet, compact terminal Markdown authoring, stable prompt-cache routing, and a separately attributable pro-mode arm; do not add another after-read tool or compiler round.
